{{Header Nav|game=Red Dead Redemption}}

In the multiplayer of ''Red Dead Redemption'', a player can progress through fifty ranks by earning experience. At each rank, they can unlock new [[Red Dead Redemption/Characters|characters]], [[Red Dead Redemption/Mounts|mounts]], [[Red Dead Redemption/Weapons|weapons]] and [[Red Dead Redemption/Titles|titles]] to use in the multiplayer game modes.
